email.subject: AI for Troutman Pepper Locke, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Amie,

Your industry-first integration of Thomson Reuters Deep Research into a proprietary AI agent caught our attention. It signals what we see across leading firms: the competitive edge now belongs to those pairing human expertise with smarter AI tools.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of complex practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Atlanta office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on energy, financial services, and health care matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
